description: OpenTabs plugin for Microsoft Word Online

tools.name: get_current_user
tools.description: Get the profile of the currently authenticated Microsoft 365 user including name and email.

tools.name: reauthenticate
tools.description: Clear cached MSAL state and reload the SharePoint/OneDrive tab to force a fresh Microsoft Graph token. Use this when another Word tool returns an authentication error pointing at this tool. After invoking, wait ~5 seconds for the tab to finish reloading, then retry the original operation.

tools.name: get_drive
tools.description: Get the current user's OneDrive information including storage quota and drive type.

tools.name: get_active_document
tools.description: Get information about the document currently open in the Word Online editor. Returns the document ID, name, and metadata. The document ID can then be used with get_document_text, update_document, append_to_document, replace_text_in_document, and other tools. This is the recommended first step — call this to discover the active document before reading or editing it.

tools.name: get_document_text
tools.description: Extract plain text content from a Word document (.docx). Downloads the binary file, decompresses the OOXML archive, and extracts text from all paragraphs. Returns paragraphs as an array of strings.

tools.name: create_document
tools.description: Create a new Word document (.docx) with the given text content. Each string in the paragraphs array becomes a separate paragraph in the document. The file is created at the specified path in OneDrive.

tools.name: update_document
tools.description: Replace the entire text content of an existing Word document (.docx). Downloads the document, replaces all body content with the new paragraphs, and re-uploads. WARNING: This removes all existing formatting (bold, italic, headings, etc.) — use replace_text_in_document for formatting-safe edits.

tools.name: append_to_document
tools.description: Append paragraphs to the end of an existing Word document (.docx). Downloads the document, adds the new paragraphs after all existing content, and re-uploads. Existing content is preserved.

tools.name: replace_text_in_document
tools.description: Find and replace text in an existing Word document (.docx). This is the recommended way to edit documents because it preserves all formatting (bold, italic, headings, styles). Replaces all occurrences of the search text with the replacement text within existing paragraph runs. The search is case-sensitive and matches exact strings.

tools.name: get_file_content
tools.description: Read text content of a file by its ID. Works with text-based files (.txt, .md, .csv, .html, .json, .xml, .yaml, .log, etc.). For Word documents (.docx), use get_document_text instead.

tools.name: list_recent_documents
tools.description: List recently accessed documents from OneDrive.

tools.name: list_children
tools.description: List files and folders in a directory. Use item_id to specify the folder, or omit for root.

tools.name: get_item
tools.description: Get metadata for a file or folder by its ID.

tools.name: search_files
tools.description: Search for files and folders by name in OneDrive.

tools.name: create_folder
tools.description: Create a new folder. Specify parent_id for nested folders, omit for root.

tools.name: upload_file
tools.description: Upload a text file to OneDrive. Creates a new file or overwrites existing. Specify the full path relative to drive root (e.g., "Documents/report.txt").

tools.name: update_file_content
tools.description: Update the content of an existing file by its ID.

tools.name: rename_item
tools.description: Rename a file or folder.

tools.name: move_item
tools.description: Move a file or folder to a new parent folder.

tools.name: copy_item
tools.description: Copy a file or folder. The copy operation is asynchronous — returns success immediately. The new copy appears in the destination folder shortly after.

tools.name: delete_item
tools.description: Permanently delete a file or folder. This action cannot be undone.

tools.name: list_shared_with_me
tools.description: List files and folders shared with the current user.

tools.name: get_preview_url
tools.description: Get an embeddable preview URL for a document. Useful for generating view-only links.

tools.name: create_sharing_link
tools.description: Create a sharing link for a file or folder. Returns a URL that can be shared with others.

tools.name: list_permissions
tools.description: List sharing permissions on a file or folder.

tools.name: delete_permission
tools.description: Remove a sharing permission from a file or folder.

tools.name: list_versions
tools.description: List version history of a file.

tools.name: restore_version
tools.description: Restore a file to a previous version.
